## Themes

- The theme gallery in Settings shows each category as a grid that wraps to the window, instead of a sideways carousel.
- Browse themes by category tab. Each category has a shuffle button, an A-Z sort, and "See all" to show every theme in it. Shuffling never moves the theme you have chosen.
- Light and dark themes are picked from a dropdown beside the search box.
- The theme gallery only builds the cards in view, so switching categories no longer freezes the window.
- The Theme settings page no longer jumps back to the top while you scroll.
- Changing the theme no longer crashes after Windows is locked and unlocked with "Everything" theme colors on.

## Settings

- Settings rows are more compact, and the pages drop their taglines and descriptions so they are quicker to scan.
- The Settings tab names the section that is open.
- Custom highlighting rules are marked again, so they can be told apart from built-in rules with the same name.

## Identities

- Settings > Identities & Keys has **Tidy up logins**, which groups the usernames, keys and saved passwords of older sessions into shared identities. Passwords that can't be read or deleted are left where they are, and any that fail to delete can be retried.

## Terminal

- Programming fonts like Cascadia Code, Fira Code and JetBrains Mono draw their ligatures (`->`, `!=`, `===` and friends) while keeping every column aligned.
- Frames draw with less waiting and copying: busy, colorful screens and large windows render faster, and keystroke echoes show sooner.
- Emoji and combining marks always match the text around them, and long combining sequences are no longer cut short.

## Rewind

- Rewind history is compressed, so the same memory limit holds several times more history. Memory stays within the limit even when the app is busy.

## Automation

- `--background` opens windows behind everything without taking focus, for scripted checks that run while you keep working.

Choose the x64 download for Intel or AMD PCs. Choose ARM64 only for Windows on ARM devices.
